actions.label: Create metadata baseline
actions.expected: The corrupt-metadata fixture begins with a packaged UI-authored document.

actions.label: Save metadata baseline
actions.expected: The Windows Save dialog persists the baseline before the copied fixture is corrupted.

actions.label: Open corrupt metadata copy
actions.expected: A native Ctrl+O sent to the exact packaged Ether window opens the document picker.

actions.label: Native unsupported metadata error
actions.expected: The exact packaged browser process presents a clear native unsupported-document error for the corrupt copy.
actions.actual: MainInstructionIcon SQLite application ID 1234 is not an Ether application ID. OK

actions.label: Capture unsupported corrupt metadata
actions.expected: The packaged app keeps the valid active baseline after the native unsupported-document error.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.
